newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-DETTORI RIDES SEVEN WINNERS OUT OF SEVEN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI RIDES SEVEN WINNERS OUT OF SEVEN.

text.p: Champion jockey Frankie Dettori went through the card on Saturday, riding all seven winners in an historic feat.
No jockey in Britain has ever ridden seven winners from seven races at one meeting.
Ex-champion Willie Carson had six winners from seven rides in an afternoon at Newcastle in 1990. In 1957 Alec Russell rode all six winners at a meeting in Scotland.

Dettori's successes were on Wall Street (2-1 favourite), Diffident (12-1), Mark of Esteem (100-30), Decorated Hero (7-1), Fatefully (7-4 favourite), Lochangel (5-4 joint favourite) and Fujiyama Crest (2-1 favourite).
The astonishing achievement came on the opening day of a high-profile two-day festival meeting, highlighted by the Queen Elizabeth 11 Stakes, won by Mark of Esteem.
Dettori said: "It's been an incredible day -- a dream come true." He added: "I definitely feel lucky. I must do the lottery tonight."
